name: Hoshiuta ~Starlight Serenade~
source:
It is autumn... A boyfriend and a girlfriend get closer little by little... But one day, their relationship suddenly changes after some accident...

[From ErogeShop]

This fandisc features afterstory of 5 heroines of original game and also adds 3 new routes for subheroines Koume, Arisa and Seiko.
